title: Introduce human-readable release abstracts and intent tagging for onboard changelogs
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: As model intake volume grows, generated changelogs become long and noisy for product and ops consumers. This PR adds two lightweight artifacts produced at model-onboard time: (1) a one-line 'release abstract' intended for humans (engineers, product managers) that summarizes the change in plain language; (2) machine-consumable 'intent tags' (performance, latency, deprecation, API-change, security, quality) plus a small 'delta_score' to rank significance. Design: - Release abstracts are generated by the existing changelog synthesizer using a concise template and an extractive+rule-based summarizer to avoid hallucination. The summarizer prefers: model family, primary change (weights/quantization/optimizer differences), and user impact. - Intent tags are derived from metadata diffs, telemetry probes, and onboarding performance profile deltas. Each tag includes a sign (+/-/neutral) and an optional short rationale string. - Delta_score is a normalized float 0-1 representing significance computed from weighted signals (latency delta, token-cost delta, eval-regression magnitude, deprecation flags). Implementation: - Introduce new database column release_abstract (string) and release_intent_tags (JSON stored as stringified payload) in model_versions table with a migration script (migrations/20241201_add_release_abstracts.sql). - Hooked into the intake pipeline: onboarder now emits a compact changelog fragment that the release-assembler consumes to produce the abstract and tags. - Console: adds a compact 'release abstract' row on the model version card and an intent-tag pill strip. - Changelog automation: allow the release-digest workflow to condense multiple onboarded changes into a short list of abstracts and to surface high delta_score entries first. Checklist: - [x] DB migration and backward-compatible reads - [x] Onboard pipeline unit tests and e2e fixture - [x] Console UI mock and integration - [x] Changelog condensation logic and tests - [x] Documentation updates under docs/onboarding/release-abstracts.md Rollout plan: staged rollout: feature flag release_abstracts enabled for 10% of intake traffic for 48h, monitor change in digest size and number of high-delta abstracts; then enable for all. Related work: ENG-2911 (changelog condensation), PRs 271828 and 74219 (cohorting and rollout heuristics) for background. Notes: The summarizer is intentionally rule-heavy to avoid creating misleading prose; a follow-up PR will experiment with a tiny LM-based abstractive pass behind a content-safety gate. Links: linear://ENG-9273, jira://SUP-3412.
commits: feat(onboard): add release abstract generation hook and templated summarizer
feat(db): add release_abstract and release_intent_tags columns to model_versions (migration)
chore(console): show release abstract and intent tags on model version card
feat(changelog): condensation pipeline prioritize by delta_score
test(onboard): add telemetry probe fixtures and unit tests for tag derivation
review_comments: Aaron Feldman (reviewer): Overall nice-sounding feature. Two concerns: 1) storing JSON as string in model_versions may make queries awkward; consider a separate table for tag rows. 2) delta_score weights are magic numbers — add tests and document defaults.

Maya Chen (author): Response: Agreed on the table option. Chose string storage to keep migration small; added rationale in migration comment and an explicit follow-up ticket ENG-9347 to normalize into a tag table. Added unit tests that assert delta_score composition and a config file with weight defaults.
Priya Nair (reviewer): UI: ensure pills truncate long rationale strings and show full text on hover. Also request an aria-label for each tag for screen readers.
Maya Chen (author): Updated console component to truncate with tooltip and added aria-labels. Screenshots attached in review.
Liam O'Sullivan (reviewer): CI flakey: the e2e on M1 runners timed out. Can we parallelize fixture setup? Also please add a migration rollback script.
Maya Chen (author): Increased fixture timeout and split the heavy fixtures; added a rollback migration file and CI retry directive for the e2e job.
release_notes: Added release abstracts (one-line human summaries) and intent tags for model onboard changelogs. Changelog condensation now prioritizes high-significance deltas. Configurable weights and a follow-up normalization plan (ENG-9347). UI shows abstracts and tag pills on model version cards.
discussion_summary: Reviewers requested a follow-up to normalize tag storage and clarified accessibility and UI truncation; CI flakiness addressed by splitting fixtures and adding retries. Feature gated behind feature flag and staged rollout planned.
notes_for_ops: When enabling feature flag at scale, monitor digest_length and number_of_abstracts metrics (onboard.digest.size, onboard.abstracts.high_delta.count). If delta_score spikes unexpectedly, rollback flag and investigate telemetry probe input distributions.
examples: Release abstract example: "Upgraded gpt-q family: 8-bit quantized checkpoint with 12% latency reduction and minor eval regression on bias benchmarks."
